text:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — pushing a small mock for the compact time-range handle + sampling affordance. screenshot: https://redwood.design/mock/2149504321.png. goals: reduce accidental drag, make sampling density clearer, keep p95 card compact. please skim for major blockers.

Ben Ortiz: looks good! quick q — when user drags to snap, do we debounce the backend update to avoid spike in requests?

Maria Chen: yes — plan is client-only optimistic preview during drag, debounce network commit. thinking 300ms debounce for preview -> commit analytics after stable. aria snippet for toggle: `<button aria-label="Sampling density toggle">Dense · Sparse</button>`.

Elaine Park: design nit — handle hit target feels small on mobile. recommend 44px min tap target and a subtle halo on focus. also copy suggestion: use `Sampling density` instead of `Sample rate` (more descriptive).

Sunil Rao: infra note — client preview is fine but if users rapidly toggle density we could see a burst of eval/aggregation calls. Can we batch or coalesce at the gateway? last-write-wins would help.

Maria Chen: agreed. updated plan: last-write-wins + 1s coalesce window for network commits. implementation idea: use `requestAnimationFrame` for scrub preview + `setTimeout` for commit. pseudo: ```js
let commitTimer
function onChange(val){ renderPreview(val)
clearTimeout(commitTimer)
commitTimer = setTimeout(()=> commitDensity(val), 1000)
}
```

Ben Ortiz: for p95 sparkline, I noticed small jumpiness when sampling density changes. suggest we animate transitions and freeze y-axis until new sample data arrives to reduce perceived jitter. :thumbsup:

Ava (design-bot): visual diff uploaded: https://ci.redwood/visuals/diff/2149504321. auto-lint: handle-label contrast 2.9 (fail). recommended contrast >= 4.5. ARIA suggestion: `aria-live="polite"` for sampling updates.

Elaine Park: accessibility nits: keyboard support — Left/Right should move by 1% steps, Shift+Left/Right 5%, Cmd/Ctrl+Left/Right 10%. add an `aria-live` region that announces "Sampling density set to X%". also ensure focus styles are visible (halo + 3px outline).

Sunil Rao: also adding e2e test ask: smoke test that toggling sampling density does not trigger layout shift or overflow in the p95 card. flagging backend to throttle commit path if >5 changes/sec from a single session.

Ben Ortiz: I'll take ownership of the frontend: increase tap target to 44px, add focus halo, implement coalesce + last-write-wins, animate chart transitions and freeze axis while loading. will add unit + e2e tests.

Maria Chen: thanks — I'll update the spec doc with the new copy and accessibility notes, and attach hi-fi before next design review. @Elaine can you produce final copy for the label and the little helper tooltip? :rocket:
